args.body:
Combined summary of Brightline's 2026 returns article (blog.brightline.example/2026/returns) and its companion piece (insights.brightline.example/returns/companion):

- Apparel return rates reached 24%, underscoring the scale of the returns challenge in retail logistics.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by roughly a fifth (~20%), showing the value of centralizing returns processing.
- Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the original margin, making rapid resale turnaround a key lever for profitability.
args.title: Brightline 2026 Returns: Blog + Companion Summary
